criteria.title: 시간·공간 cutoff 선택
criteria.text:
q≤C0(τ+|z|^(1/D))로support를q<q*/2 안에놓고c=χxχt를선택한다. χx는r²,z에smooth하게둔다. 합격: u=p=0인

criteria.acceptanceScope: The actual unchanged common6 initial source premises, original positive mean-map inverses, pulse/frame estimates and fixed covariance denominators were executed and bound to Lemma9.7. Proposition9.9 permits the same qStar=qBig; the exact choice qBig=qCommon/64 gives support q<=qBig/4<qBig/2. The same smooth r^2/z cutoff operator has a positive initial zero interval, fixed compact K and exact unit plateau near the origin. The observed source gate passed11/11 with52 independent Fraction checks and101 unchanged dependency files. This completes the original cutoff/domain criterion. The source-theorem application is explicit; no new Lean proof, nonzero final N6 field, full localized force or whole-K active energy is claimed.

criterionDependencyReview.whyFullFieldEvaluationIsNotRequiredForTh: These support and zero-extension conclusions hold for the complete localization operator without evaluating its field operands. Lemma9.7 fixes its sufficient domain from the executed initial coefficients. Later field sizes affect derivative constants, not a new smaller domain.
